frozen_before: Implementation and replay of the corrected table-role feature extraction; second external eight websites remain unscored.
changes: Feature semantics correction only. No model training, weight changes, threshold changes, group key changes, or new expert selection.
verified_primary_column: Existing non-job header recognition: exactly one title/name column, all direct header cells th, no spans, matching data row width with no spans.
verified_primary_target: At most 20 inspected anchors in the primary cell, all belonging to this table. Exactly one unique non-fragment raw href. More anchors, multiple targets, absent links, or unsafe canonicalization leave prior features unchanged.
features: For every anchor in such a row, canonical primary-target equality sets semantic_title and record_primary_url; a different target sets record_other_primary. Same-target links in other cells are primary aliases. All other features and the 84-feature schema stay unchanged.
exclusions: Job application routing, unknown/ambiguous headers, nested table links, colspan/rowspan, multiple primary targets, and linkless primary cells retain their prior behavior. No hostnames, dataset IDs, or subject-specific URL rules.

all 63 historical and 51 breadth disclosed regression pages
untouched second external eight only if all previous gates pass
additional_guard: Do not hide large per-source false-positive explosions in aggregate metrics.
dataset_policy: Preserve every original frozen feature export. Any refreshed feature export must use a new v5 filename and record source/model/feature hashes. No refreshed final holdout export until prior gates pass.
